title: Design System: QueUA — The Registrar's Vellum

display.purpose: Instrument Serif. Page/hero titles and the lobby 'Now Serving.' only — never a second sans headline.

headline.purpose: Geist 700. Console and board page headings.

title.purpose: Geist 600. Card titles, ticket numbers in lists, row headers.

body.purpose: Geist 400. Default running text and controls.

label.purpose: Geist Mono, uppercase, 0.18em tracking. Eyebrows, chips; tabular-nums for all figures and ticket numbers.

shadows.name: field-focus-ring
shadows.purpose: The only shadow in the system — focused input fields, paired with a solid Electric Blue border. The system is otherwise flat.

motion.name: kinetic-ease
motion.purpose: Easing for the 0.6s kinetic-rise reveal on display headings (translateY + fade + tracking settle). Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: marquee
motion.purpose: Lobby ticker scroll (~32s). Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The quiet authoritative default action — ink fill on vellum.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:.4rem; background:#151513; color:#f4f3ee; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:3px; padding:.55rem 1rem; font-family:Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size:.875rem; font-weight:500; line-height:1; transition:background-color .15s ease, transform .05s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#2a2a26; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #3458f4; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Accent Button
components.description: The loud call to action — Call Next, Confirm.
components.css: .ds-btn-accent { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; background:#3458f4; color:#fff; border:none; border-radius:3px; padding:.55rem 1rem; font-family:Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size:.875rem; font-weight:600; line-height:1; transition:filter .15s ease, transform .05s ease; } .ds-btn-accent:hover { filter:brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-accent:active { transform:translateY(1px); }

components.name: Acid Button
components.description: The signature accent button (e.g. Enable announcements on the dark board).
components.css: .ds-btn-acid { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:.4rem; background:#d6ff3f; color:#151513; border:none; border-radius:3px; padding:.55rem 1rem; font-family:Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size:.875rem; font-weight:600; line-height:1; } .ds-btn-acid:active { transform:translateY(1px); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action — hairline border, fills vellum-dim on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; background:transparent; color:#151513; border:1px solid #d7d6cf; border-radius:3px; padding:.55rem 1rem; font-family:Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size:.875rem; font-weight:500; line-height:1; transition:background-color .15s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background:#eceae2; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: White cut-out in the paper with a hairline stroke; blue glow on focus.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display:block; font-family:'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size:.6875rem; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.18em; color:#6d6d66; margin-bottom:.4rem; } .ds-field { width:100%; background:#fff; color:#151513; border:1px solid #d7d6cf; border-radius:3px; padding:.55rem .75rem; font-family:Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size:.95rem; } .ds-field:focus { outline:none; border-color:#3458f4; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, #3458f4 18%, transparent); }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Full-round mono chip; tinted only to carry state meaning. Shown: OPEN.
components.css: .ds-pill { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; border-radius:999px; padding:.1rem .6rem; font-family:'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size:.6875rem; font-weight:500; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.08em; } .ds-pill-open { background:#dcfce7; color:#15803d; }

components.name: Eyebrow + Card
components.description: Flat vellum surface, one hairline border, mono eyebrow over a serif/mono value.
components.css: .ds-card { background:#f8f7f4; border:1px solid #d7d6cf; border-radius:3px; padding:16px; } .ds-eyebrow { font-family:'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size:.6875rem; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.18em; color:#6d6d66; margin:0 0 .5rem; } .ds-ticket { font-family:'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; font-size:2rem; font-weight:600; color:#151513; margin:0; }

components.name: Lobby Serving Card
components.description: The inverted signature surface: ink ground, acid-lime border and number for distance reading.
components.css: .ds-lobby-card { background:rgba(214,255,63,0.06); border:1px solid #d6ff3f; border-radius:3px; padding:24px; } .ds-lobby-eyebrow { font-family:'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size:.6875rem; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.18em; color:rgba(244,243,238,.55); margin:0; } .ds-lobby-label { color:rgba(244,243,238,.8); font-family:Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size:1.125rem; margin:.25rem 0 0; } .ds-lobby-number { font-family:'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; font-size:3.5rem; font-weight:600; color:#d6ff3f; margin:1rem 0 0; }

narrative.overview: QueUA looks like the records office of a university rendered as a calm editorial object: a warm sheet of vellum, near-black ink, hairline rules, and a kinetic serif headline that reads like the title of a document. It is an Operate system, so the interface recedes and the work leads. Against that quiet ground, color is used generously and purposefully: electric blue carries interaction and wayfinding, acid-lime is the system's signature spark. The public lobby display inverts the whole world — ink ground, paper text, acid highlights — so it reads across a room. The anti-reference is the default SaaS dashboard: cool gray-on-white, drop-shadowed cards, rounded-everything, blue-600 buttons.
keyCharacteristics: Warm vellum ground (#f4f3ee), never pure white as the page.
Instrument Serif for display; Geist for UI; Geist Mono for every label, eyebrow, and number.
Flat by default — structure is drawn with a single hairline rule, not elevation.
Near-square 3px corners; pills reserved for status only.
Generous, deliberate accents: electric blue for action, acid-lime as signature.

rules.name: The Paper Ground Rule
rules.body: Every page sits on Vellum (#f4f3ee), never on pure white. White is reserved exclusively for the interior of input fields, so a field reads as a cut-out in the paper.

rules.name: The Generous Accent Rule
rules.body: Accents are used liberally for affordance and wayfinding, not rationed — electric blue marks anything actionable, acid-lime carries signature and emphasis. What keeps the system calm is the neutral ground doing the heavy lifting, not scarcity of color.

rules.name: The Status-Color Exception
rules.body: Beyond the brand accents, amber/red/green are permitted only to carry meaning in state (on-hold, destructive, success). They never decorate.

rules.name: The Serif Display Rule
rules.body: Only Instrument Serif carries display type. Geist never plays the hero; a second sans headline is a failure of the system.

rules.name: The Mono Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Every eyebrow, field label, status chip, and above all every ticket number and metric is Geist Mono — uppercase for labels, tabular-nums for figures. Numbers are register entries, not body text.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Structure is drawn with one 1px Chalk-Line (#d7d6cf) border. Surfaces are flat at rest; if you reach for a drop shadow to separate two things, use a rule or a tonal step instead.

dos: Do put every surface on the Vellum ground (#f4f3ee) and reserve pure white for input interiors only.
Do set page/hero titles in Instrument Serif and everything operational in Geist; set all labels, eyebrows, ticket numbers, and metrics in Geist Mono.
Do separate planes with a single 1px Chalk-Line (#d7d6cf) border or a tonal step to Vellum-Dim.
Do use Electric Blue for anything actionable and Acid-Lime as the signature accent, freely and purposefully.
Do keep corners near-square (3px); use the 999px pill only for status chips.
Do invert to the Ink ground + Acid-Lime world for the public lobby display, and respect prefers-reduced-motion on the kinetic headline and marquee.
donts: Don't use drop shadows to float cards; this system is flat — reach for a rule or a tonal step.
Don't render a second sans-serif headline or let Geist play display; the serif owns that register.
Don't introduce cool grays or pure-white page backgrounds — that is the generic-SaaS anti-reference.
Don't let the semantic status colors (amber/red/green) decorate; they appear only to carry state meaning.
Don't round everything into pills; pills are for status only.
